prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, a generated monochrome cup icon. Image 2 is the accepted app style reference; match its flat filled rounded calculator symbols, not the screenshot layout. Change only the single cup symbol as specified. Preserve a genuinely transparent square background, one flat uniform near-black ink (#30323b) with zero texture, gradient, glow, shadow, perspective lighting or stray pixels. All rim/handle openings and the specified gaps must be true transparent alpha. Return exactly one complete centered icon, no text, tiled sheet or UI. Keep even transparent padding and fill about 80–85% of the canvas's longest dimension with the icon. Shape and broad negative spaces must stay readable at 24 px. Keep the petite rounded cup and small right handle, but increase the uninterrupted gap between cup and saucer to about 7% of the entire icon height so it remains clearly separate when rendered at 24 px. Make the saucer much shallower: thickness about 5–6% of the complete icon height, with rounded tips and no upturned giant bowl. Widen the narrow left side of the handle opening slightly. Preserve a broad single mouth opening and solid filled cup body.
